# God of Prompt

> > God of Prompt is a comprehensive AI prompt library and resource hub featuring 30,000+ prompts, custom GPTs, and practical guides for leveraging ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, and other AI tools for business growth and content creation.

Founded by Robert Youssef and featuring contributions from Alex Prompter, God of Prompt serves marketers, entrepreneurs, and content creators seeking to master prompt engineering and AI workflow automation. The platform offers both free resources and premium prompt collections for marketing, e-commerce, and business automation.

## Key Topics

- ChatGPT prompts
- Prompt engineering
- AI tools and platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Gemini)
- Content creation automation
- Business automation and workflow optimization
- Marketing prompts and conversion optimization
- Custom GPTs for business
- AI monetization strategies
- E-commerce automation
- Beginner-friendly AI guides
- AI education and courses
- Productivity tools
- Automated copywriting
- AI ethics and transparency
- Video script generation
